readout_other: whole-cell patch clamp; fEPSP slope (LTP); c-Fos immunofluorescence; infrared thermal imaging; laser Doppler vibrometry
direction_notes: Continuous ultrasound at 0.31 MPa increased CA3 neuronal firing; 100-Hz pulsed ultrasound at 1.08 and 1.46 MPa induced LTP-like potentiation of Schaffer collateral fEPSPs, increasing with pressure.

exposures.label: On-chip SAW ultrasound to CA3 of hippocampal slice (continuous and 100-Hz pulsed)

device.model: miniature ultrasound neuro-stimulation chip with interdigital transducers (IDTs) on lithium niobate

timing.protocol_description: Continuous waves for 30 or 300 s at 0.31 MPa (neuronal activation test); pulsed waves (0.59-1.46 MPa, 1-ms pulses, 100-Hz PRF) delivered as three trains with a 10-s interval and 23 s total stimulation duration for LTP induction.

This stimulator emits a synchronization signal that triggers the arbitrary waveform generator and generates ultrasonic waves to stimulate the CA3 region of hippocampal slices for LTP induction.
